_comment: Pinned inputs of the Windows package that this repository cannot download or hash itself. python_embeddable.sha256 was computed on the Windows build machine from python-3.12.10-embed-amd64.zip downloaded from python.org and compared ONLY with the MD5 that python.org lists for that file (not SHA-256, not GPG or Sigstore). TODO(HUMAN-VERIFY): MD5-checked download only; Sigstore or GPG verification not done. stage_package.py refuses a zip whose sha256 differs, and refuses a pin that is not 64 hex digits.
_comment_onnxruntime: onnxruntime_win_x64: the ONNX Runtime the helper programs load (ort 2.0.0-rc.13 needs API 1.27.x). The zip sha256 was computed 2026-10-11 from the file downloaded from github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime and equals the digest the GitHub releases API shows (same origin, NOT independent). TODO(HUMAN-VERIFY): compare it with a second source (see dev-docs/HUMAN-TODO.md section 12). dll_sha256 is the hash of lib/onnxruntime.dll inside that zip. stage_package.py refuses a zip or a dll that differs.
